Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Brand Studio team works on a variety of brand-centric projects for Stripe, from our brand standards to campaigns, events, IRL experiences, packaging, digital products, and even printed publications. The brand designers on this team are multidisciplinary in nature, able to design robust visual systems, art direction, and craft surfaces that focus on brand and product storytelling. 

Collaborating with other teams at Stripe, as well as external partners, we raise the quality and consistency of experiences with the Stripe brand IRL, virtually, and everywhere in between. We craft the creative vision and strategy for different types of projects and audiences, and amplify them across various mediums, channels, objects to environments, and digital and physical experiences.

About Stripe Creative Lab

Stripe Creative Lab aims to create breakthrough, culturally resonant, and exquisitely crafted projects that reveal Stripe’s magic in surprising ways. We dedicate ourselves to meticulously crafting the work to ensure the highest possible creative quality. The work is experimental, often starts with ambiguous briefs and requires finding a way where others might deem it impossible. We are making it up as we go, and that’s the way we love to work.

What you’ll do

You’ll be joining a highly creative team that spans the gamut of creative execution, from digital experiences (like interactive games or live-streaming a handbuilt, miniature city) to physical activations (like retrofitting CRT monitors or retired MTA ticketing machines) and beyond. The work is highly experimental, idea-driven, and very collaborative. 

The work starts with ideas. Your ability to generate original and interesting concepts is foundational, as is your ability to find the right form for them and bring them to life, both with your own hands and through close collaboration with people across a wide range of disciplines.

Responsibilities

  • Be an adamant maker that is genuinely curious, experimental, and loves to tinker, iterate quickly, and innovate on ideas, narrative, and making beautiful things
  • Creative vision: Design execution and quality of ideas work in equal partnership
  • Collaborate with like-minded creative people who have radically different skill sets and together create ideas that envision an optimistic, progressive future
  • Help shape the strategic vision for design that pushes the boundaries of the brand and build awareness for what we do and why it’s important to Stripe
  • Partner widely with cross-functional teams to build upon great ideas through making things
  • Give and solicit feedback from wide range of teammates, agency partners, and stakeholders
  • Generate original, conceptually strong ideas from ambiguous briefs, strategic problems, cultural observations, and emerging opportunities 
  • Determine the right form for an idea, then direct multidisciplinary collaborators to bring it to life across a wide range of mediums
  • Develop clear creative narratives, pitches, references, treatments, and prototypes that make an idea compelling before its final execution is known

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of relevant creative experience in concepting and delivering ideas 
  • Experience creating and directing experimental work across a variety of mediums, disciplines, and collaborators
  • Strong track record independently delivering work as well as influencing the work of other designers, contractors, and agencies
  • A strong strategic acumen for building leading brands in a fast paced, global facing environment
  • Exceptional craft
  • A portfolio demonstrating exceptional conceptual thinking and art direction across a range of formats and disciplines
  • Exceptional visual and cultural taste, with a broad frame of reference extending beyond design

Preferred qualifications

  • Are genuinely curious, ambitious and creative with a refreshing sense of design, art, technology, and culture
  • Are persuasive and humble in explaining your work, process, and decisions and experienced at facilitating stakeholders to advance the project as well as design quality 
  • Have excellent organization and presentation skills, and excel in written and verbal communication
  • Love working with other designers to help them learn and grow (and invite them to help you do the same)
  • Have experience working in or alongside highly conceptual advertising, design, or cultural studios
  • Experience working with cross functional partners
  • Proficient in the latest AI and creative tools
  • Creative coding or creative technologist background is a nice to have

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Platform Sales team works with B2B Software Platforms to help them facilitate payments for their customers using our Stripe Connect product. Platforms already using Stripe include Shopify, Treatwell, Sage & DesignMyNight. 

As a key member to the Stripe Platforms team, you will manage and elevate relationships with a named account list of Stripe existing users and prospects while identifying new growth opportunities and ways Stripe can exceed expectations. 

What you’ll do

As an Account Executive (Grower), you will create partnerships between Stripe and the most innovative and fastest-growing software platforms in the world by helping them to understand how Stripe’s online commerce infrastructure can make payments a competitive advantage for their businesses.

Responsibilities

  • Directly manage and nurture a named account list and develop account plans for winning and expanding business with upper middle market and enterprise SaaS Platform companies
  • Build and maintain key relationships with C-level executives, while orchestrating the right executive touch points as well
  • Own the full sales cycle from lead to close for upper middle market and enterprise companies
  • Work with company leaders from multiple functions (e.g., Engineering, Product, and Finance) to lead complex product workshops and financial analyse
  • Craft and lead complex, bespoke commercial & contractual negotiations
  • Contribute to shaping our platform partnership strategy and building repeatable processes and scaled engagement models
  • Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process
  • Engage with Product and Engineering teams to help drive product strategy

Who you are

You are an adept salesperson and relationship manager capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including the CEO, CTO, COO, and CFO. You have experience working with upper middle market and enterprise companies. You have an in-depth understanding of the buyer journey and can lead a complex, multi-party sale in a highly consultative manner. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding, combined with technical knowledge. You are naturally analytical and enjoy digging into business models and helping customers quantify their investment decisions. You get excited about prospecting, and are capable of independently leading a sales cycle from start to finish. Finally, you enjoy building – you like to actively participate in the development of our sales process, the articulation of our value proposition, and the creation of key tools and assets.

If you’re ambitious, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!

Minimum requirements

  • 7+ years of sales experience, preferably selling a technical product, with a track record of top performance
  • Extensive experience directly selling a technology product or service, preferably at an API-first company, with a record of top performance
  • A proven track record of moving sales processes forward from inception to close by leading complex, multi-party sales in a highly consultative manner, understanding strategies and applying value proposition
  • Great listening skills and ability to quickly become a trusted resource for decision-makers across technology and finance orgs within software companies
  • An ability to understand complex technical problems and understand how Stripe’s solutions can address them
  • A positive attitude and tireless work ethic when encountering blockers to success, whether external or internal
  • Strong presentation skills
  • Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills in English and Spanish
  • Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment
  • Strong interest in technology and a deep understanding of the space
  • Experience in or excitement in learning about financial technology infrastructure
  • Fastidious approach to CRM hygiene and experience utilizing thorough sales forecasting metrics on a weekly/quarterly basis and communicating them in a succinct manner

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in our Bucharest, Romania site have an 80% in-office expectation, and those in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico and Bengaluru, India work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

descriptions.job-1ecphky:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. 

Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.

Your role

Stripe is large enough that individual products and projects can be rapidly deployed to a meaningful fraction of the world’s businesses, but small enough that individual agency still has outsized impact. Small teams can impact how millions of businesses grow. Right now the global economy is replatforming around AI, creating new opportunities for growth. We’re at the center of this, and we think the best work is still in front of us.

To meet this moment, we’re looking for people who move with urgency, like hard problems, and want their work to matter at a time of great change. If that’s you, there’s no better place to build your career.

Who you are

  • Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.
  • Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. 
  • Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities.  At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

Minimum requirements

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science or a directly related field, obtained by summer 2027, or equivalent work experience; New grad candidates should have no more than 18 months of professional experience (excluding internship experience).
  • Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.
  • Experience from either previous internships or working collaboratively on multi-person coding projects (in a university or professional setting).
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts.
  • Clear written communication skills, with the ability to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes.
  • Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.

Preferred qualifications

  • One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge. 
  • Experience in code review practices, and an understanding of how to safely update production systems.
  • Familiarity with navigating and managing work in large code bases.
  • Experience leading small projects independently, and contributing to larger projects alongside peers.
  • Ability to operate with high agency in navigating complex technical obstacles independently, knowing precisely when to unblock oneself and when to ask for help.
descriptions.job-1cctgn6:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Hut 8 is seeking a Cybersecurity Architect to lead security design and build the technical capabilities that protect the enterprise. This role translates the technology and cybersecurity strategy into practical architecture, reusable design patterns, technical standards, and implemented security capabilities across corporate IT, mining operations, data centers, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, enterprise data, and AI/compute environments.

The Cybersecurity Architect is the lead security designer and builder: a senior technical individual contributor who turns strategy into architecture, guides implementation, and builds durable security capabilities. The role partners closely with Software, Networking, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Applied AI, Technology Operations, Data Center Operations, Mining Operations, and other arm of the business to embed security into technology decisions without creating unnecessary delivery friction.

This role reports to the Cybersecurity Partner and works closely with technology leadership, and external security partners.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the design of Hut 8’s security architecture principles, reference architectures, technical standards, and security-by-default patterns, then build the capabilities needed to apply them consistently.
  • Translate cybersecurity strategy, risk priorities, and business requirements into executable architecture decisions and implementation roadmaps.
  • Lead security architecture reviews for new platforms, applications, integrations, cloud services, infrastructure changes, AI/compute workloads, and operational technology environments.
  • Design defense-in-depth architectures across identity and access management, privileged access, network segmentation, endpoint security, cloud, SaaS, application security, data security, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and OT or industrial control environments.
  • Define practical security requirements for systems and services, including authentication, authorization, encryption, logging, monitoring, resiliency, secrets management, vulnerability management, and incident response readiness.
  • Partner with engineering and technology teams to secure integrations, APIs, production platforms, data pipelines, and software delivery processes throughout the technology lifecycle.
  • Develop reusable security patterns and guardrails that enable teams to deliver securely and consistently at scale.
  • Identify material technology risks, evaluate alternatives, document decisions, and recommend risk-based treatment options to technology and business leaders.
  • Guide the design and evolution of security capabilities such as SIEM and security monitoring, EDR, vulnerability management, IAM, privileged access, cloud security, and security testing.
  • Review third-party products, vendors, and managed services for architectural fit, security risk, control coverage, and operational accountability.
  • Support threat modeling, attack-surface analysis, technical risk assessments, incident preparedness, and post-incident architectural remediation.
  • Establish architecture documentation, diagrams, standards, decision records, and operating procedures that make the security program repeatable and auditable.
  • Partner with GRC and audit stakeholders to ensure that security architecture and control decisions are documented, testable, and supported by evidence.
  • Mentor cybersecurity engineers and technical stakeholders on secure design, risk-based decision-making, operational discipline, and incident readiness.
  • Provide clear technical recommendations, tradeoffs, and status updates to the Cybersecurity Partner and technology leadership.


ABOUT YOU

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, information security, security architecture, security engineering, or a comparable technical discipline.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent practical experience will be considered.
  • Strong knowledge of security architecture across identity, network, endpoint, cloud, SaaS, application, data, and infrastructure environments.
  • Experience designing security controls and reference patterns for cloud platforms, enterprise applications, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, production systems, and data environments.
  • Familiarity with OT, industrial control, data center, or other operational technology environments, with the ability to adapt enterprise security principles to operational realities.
  • Experience with security architecture methods, threat modeling, risk assessments, zero trust principles, defense-in-depth design, and secure systems development practices.
  • Working knowledge of security frameworks and control environments, including NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2, SOX ITGC, PCI, or comparable standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous requirements into practical architecture decisions and drive adoption through implementation.
  • Strong technical writing and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex security decisions to engineers, operators, executives, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working with security vendors, MSSPs, auditors, and third parties, with the judgment to hold partners accountable for measurable outcomes.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, TOGAF, GIAC, or cloud security certifications are preferred.
  • Pragmatic, collaborative, and comfortable operating hands-on in a fast-moving environment where the security program is continuing to mature.

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role is in office at our corporate headquarters in the Brickell area of Miami, Florida. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

FUNCTION: Engineering

We are seeking an experienced Information Security Manager to join our Security team.

The Information Security Manager at BVNK is instrumental in establishing and maintaining a robust framework for managing operational risks related to information security with a strong emphasis on compliance with Brazilian financial regulations. The primary focus will be the establishment and implementation of the necessary changes to the global frameworks, documentation and workflows to ensure compliance with local regulations. This involves identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks across business processes, technology platforms, third-party engagements, and regulatory compliance requirements. The Manager will collaborate across the organization, ensuring operational resilience and alignment with the overall risk appetite and security strategy.

Key Areas of Responsibilities:

Brazil License & Regulatory Compliance

  • Oversee the modification and implementation of changes to the global information security operational risk and ICT control framework required to support the application for and maintenance of the Brazilian VASP financial license under BCB Resolution 520/25.
  • Coordinate with local legal representatives, external counsel, and regulatory authorities (including the Central Bank of Brazil) to ensure information security policies and operational resilience mechanisms remain fully compliant with Brazilian regulatory standards.
  • Oversee the creation of the necessary technical controls, their implementation and continuous operation, including reporting and monitoring.

Risk Identification and Assessment

  • Update and manage the information security operational risk register, ensuring accurate classification, measurement, and reporting of identified risks.
  • Conduct regular operational ICT risk assessments across critical business processes, IT systems, and applications to identify control weaknesses and potential impact scenarios.
  • Collaborate with business process owners to integrate ICT risk controls and ensure adherence to the 'three lines of defense' model.
  • Integrate and monitor internal fraud controls specifically related to IT systems, processes, and privileged access, establishing necessary detection and prevention mechanisms.

Audits and Compliance Management

  • Support internal and external audit processes, including collecting evidence, managing audit requests, and ensuring continuous compliance with regulatory standards.

Risk Mitigation and Control Management

  • Design, implement, and monitor key risk indicators (KRIs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) for IT security controls and processes.
  • Facilitate the control self-assessment process, verifying the existence and effectiveness of security controls across the organization.

Investigations, Policies, and Training

  • Investigate and create comprehensive reports regarding fraud cases, security incidents, and privacy violations, ensuring timely follow-up on remediation measures.
  • Conduct operational risk reviews of client processes and tools, presenting recommendations on identified security gaps and creating initiatives for fraud prevention.
  • Develop new documents for Security Related Policies and update current policies.
  • Create new documents for other departments related to Security or information security topics.

What we need from you:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in operational risk management, IT risk, IT audit, or information security governance roles.
  • Professional certifications such as CRISC, CISSP, CISM, or similar are highly desirable.
  • Experience with SOC 1 and Vanta will be considered a strong plus.
  • Experience and deep knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory standards related to information security in the financial sector.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop, implement, and maintain an operational risk framework, ideally within an information security context.
  • Strong understanding of security controls, governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) principles.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on translating technical risks into business context.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, capable of influencing stakeholders across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Proficiency in utilising GRC tools and platforms for risk and control management.

What you can expect from us:

  • Fair and competitive salary at every stage of your growth
  • Flexible working hours, with hybrid working at its heart
  • A culture built on passionate, growth-minded people
  • A flexible approach to holiday
  • Opportunities to travel to our offices around the world
  • An open and creative environment where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets

At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we’d encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team.

About Bitdeer:

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for Bitcoin mining and AI cloud.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers. Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer operates globally with a diversified 3 GW energy portfolio, and deploys Bitcoin mining and HPC datacenters in the United States, Bhutan, Norway, Canada, Malaysia, and Ethiopia.

About the role

We are seeking a Technical Writer to own end-to-end developer documentation for Bitdeer AI's MaaS platform, spanning API reference, getting-started guides, and release notes for a fast-moving catalog of hosted chat, completion, embedding, and fine-tuning endpoints. Today, developers integrating against our inference API frequently have to reverse-engineer request and response shapes from internal Postman collections, ask engineering directly in Slack, or discover breaking parameter changes only after their integration fails in production, which slows time-to-first-successful-call and generates avoidable support load on the engineering team. This role fixes that by turning our OpenAPI specifications, model catalog, and endpoint behavior into accurate, versioned, always-current documentation that developers can trust as the single source of truth, and by establishing a release notes cadence that keeps pace with model and endpoint updates. The person who succeeds here is comfortable reading Go service code and API diffs well enough to write precisely about them, treats documentation as a product with its own release cycle rather than an afterthought, and can work independently across multiple engineering teams to pull accurate technical detail out of people who are not naturally inclined to write it down themselves.

What you will be responsible for:

  • API Reference Ownership: Maintain and continuously improve the OpenAPI-driven API reference covering chat/completions, embeddings, fine-tuning, and model routing endpoints. Verify that documented request/response schemas, error codes, and rate limits match actual service behavior by testing against staging and production endpoints. Work directly with backend engineers to capture new parameters, deprecations, and behavioral edge cases before they ship to customers.
  • Getting-Started and Onboarding Guides: Design and maintain the guides that take a new developer from signing up to making their first successful inference call, including authentication, SDK quickstarts, and common integration patterns across supported languages. Continuously identify drop-off points in the onboarding funnel through support tickets and developer feedback, and rewrite the weakest steps first. Keep sample code runnable and tested against the live API rather than left to go stale.
  • Release Notes and Changelog Discipline: Establish and run a recurring release notes process tied to model catalog updates, new endpoints, pricing changes, and breaking API changes, so developers are never surprised by a change in production. Coordinate with product and engineering release cadences to publish notes before or at the moment of rollout, and clearly flag deprecations, migration steps, and timelines for removal.
  • Docs-as-Code Pipeline and Information Architecture: Own the documentation toolchain (Markdown/MDX, Git-based review, OpenAPI spec linting and generation) so that docs are versioned, reviewable, and testable the same way code is. Organize the growing surface area of models, endpoints, and guides into an information architecture that stays navigable as the model catalog expands. Reduce duplicated or contradictory content across reference, guides, and internal wikis.
  • Cross-functional Technical Fact-Finding: Interview engineers, PMs, and support staff to extract accurate technical detail on new features, model behavior quirks, and known limitations, and turn ad hoc knowledge into structured, discoverable documentation. Sit in on model launch and API design reviews early enough to document decisions and rationale, not just final syntax, and push back when proposed APIs or error messages would be confusing to document or to use.
  • Developer Feedback Loop: Instrument and monitor documentation usage signals (search queries with no results, support tickets referencing missing or wrong docs, doc page feedback) to prioritize what to fix next. Report recurring documentation gaps back to engineering and product as a proxy for API usability issues, not just writing quality issues.

How you will stand out:

  • Bring 5+ years of professional technical writing experience with at least 2 years focused on API or SDK documentation for a developer-facing product, ideally at an API-first, infrastructure, or cloud/AI platform company.
  • Demonstrate hands-on experience authoring and maintaining OpenAPI/Swagger specifications and generating reference documentation from them, rather than hand-writing reference docs from scratch.
  • Show a portfolio of published getting-started guides, quickstarts, or tutorials that took a developer from zero to a working integration, with clear evidence you wrote (not just edited) the technical content.
  • Have working familiarity with a docs-as-code toolchain: Markdown/MDX, Git-based version control and pull request review, and static site generators or documentation platforms (e.g., Docusaurus, Mintlify, ReadMe, GitBook, or equivalent).
  • Be comfortable reading code (Go, Python, or TypeScript) and API traces well enough to verify documentation accuracy independently, without waiting on engineering to hand you finished specs.

Interviewing with TRM

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft.
